prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1237; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports other vehicle merged into their lane without signaling. Police report requested. No citation issued at scene per insured.

Entry 2: Claimant's representing attorney's office contacted adjuster. Requested all correspondence be directed to counsel going forward. Claimant reports back strain following impact. Medical authorization and treatment records requested through counsel.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos of both vehicles. Damage consistent with side-to-side contact at low speed. Rear quarter panel and passenger door damage noted on insured vehicle. Independent appraisal assigned.

Entry 4: Received initial treatment records from claimant's provider. Diagnosis of lumbar strain with recommended physical therapy. Prior history of back complaints not documented in records received so far. Requested prior records through counsel.

Entry 5: Liability position under review. Witness statement obtained from passenger in insured vehicle supporting account of other vehicle changing lanes into insured's path. Bodily injury evaluation on hold pending completion of treatment and receipt of prior records. Counsel notified of status.
